scheme_name: Assistance for Energy and Water Conservation
other_conditions: The unit must have made the investment on or after 1st April 2017.
At least 60% of the employment must be to people of the Union Territory of Puducherry and must be maintained for the period specified in the affidavit.
The unit must achieve a minimum of 10% saving in energy/water based on average monthly consumption of the previous 12 months before the audit.
The audit must be conducted by a recognized institution/consultant.

The industrial unit shall not transfer or dispose of the fixed asset, including plant and machinery, for five years from the date of submitting the application or disbursement of the subsidy, whichever is later.
Additional investments made after the first claim are also eligible for subsidy up to the ceiling limit.
Units owned by the same proprietor or common partners are eligible as separate entities if they are located at different sites and have separate licences/clearances/registrations.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of 50% of the audit fees up to ₹25,000, disbursed as a subsidy to the industrial unit.
